dependencyProvenance.description: Recorded available learning-input exposure, not proof of causal use. Optional for legacy interpretations; present null is invalid. Preview fit_id may be null even when coverage is complete. Runtime additionally checks sorted unique terms/source IDs, term total equality and strict Python integer types.

dependencyPlan.description: Read-only projection of recorded computational exposure. Complete means recorded coverage only. No inference, fitting or replay. Runtime owns snapshot consistency, ordering, unique affected IDs and cross-field counter relationships.

choiceOptions.description: Runtime requires unique option IDs and user-reviewed, explicitly supplied impacts; no inferred NLP impacts.

group_reviewed.description: Explicit user review of this event's group; separate from training consent and choice labels.

model_active.description: Feedback eligibility under source double approval, independent training consent, explicit group review, current content/version and feedback epoch; distinct from input rule-model activity.

contrastBasis.description: Orthonormal contrast span in valueFeature order. Derived geometry only; runtime checks finiteness, orthonormality and zero entries in unused columns. This engineering guard does not establish statistical validity.

preferenceResult.description: Read-only database operation; recalculates temporary CPU fit weights from eligible explicit labels. Eight ML feature weights are separate from thirteen rule parameters. No encoder training or persisted fit weights.

training_groups.description: Informative reviewed group keys in this fit; count is an exploratory gate, not evidence of independence.

password.description: Runtime additionally caps UTF-8 encoding at 1024 bytes; never trim or log.

model_active.description: Rule-source activity: status agreed and source epoch equals the snapshot epoch. Independent of feedback consent or qualification.

inputDuplicates.description: Read-only advisory exact BINARY equality of current stored raw text among application inputs, across all partitions, kinds, statuses and model epochs. Excludes the target and legacy store-only sources. No normalization, history search, inferred review, grouping, consent, merge or fitting. Runtime enforces ordering, snapshot consistency and truncated = total > items.length; the bound limits output, not the text scan.

translation.description: Lexical report in preview.translation; philosophy sources use the diary lexical pipeline. Local corrections affect interpretation/effects, not this raw report.
